issue.title: [fdbsyncd][EVPN-MH] OIF nexthop delete emits L2NHG DEL although matching create was ignored

failure.body:
### Description

When EVPN NVO is configured, `fdbsyncd` processes Linux `RTM_NEWNEXTHOP` and `RTM_DELNEXTHOP` notifications.

For an `RTM_NEWNEXTHOP` containing `NHA_OIF`, `fdbsyncd` intentionally ignores the object because it is not an L2 nexthop that belongs in `L2_NEXTHOP_GROUP_TABLE`:

```cpp
if (msg->nlmsg_type == RTM_NEWNEXTHOP)
{
    if (has_oif)
    {
        SWSS_LOG_INFO("NHG %u has OIF, dropping", nhid);
        return;
    }
}
```

However, the corresponding `RTM_DELNEXTHOP` path unconditionally publishes a DEL operation without checking whether the ID was previously accepted and inserted into `m_l2NhgMap`:

```cpp
else if (msg->nlmsg_type == RTM_DELNEXTHOP)
{
    m_l2NhgTable.del(to_string(nhid));
    m_l2NhgMap.erase(nhid);

    SWSS_LOG_INFO("L2_NEXTHOP_GROUP_TABLE: DEL nhid=%u", nhid);
}
```

Orchagent receives this unmatched DEL and reports:

```text
deleteL2Nhg: Can't delete L2NHG '<id>': does not exist
```

Relevant source:

- [OIF create filtering](https://github.com/nvidia-sonic/sonic-swss/blob/b1990a3c34ef7642f03f62849c9af5dffb1d66bf/fdbsyncd/fdbsync.cpp#L1197-L1204)
- [Unconditional delete](https://github.com/nvidia-sonic/sonic-swss/blob/b1990a3c34ef7642f03f62849c9af5dffb1d66bf/fdbsyncd/fdbsync.cpp#L1291-L1297)
- [Orchagent missing-object error](https://github.com/nvidia-sonic/sonic-swss/blob/b1990a3c34ef7642f03f62849c9af5dffb1d66bf/orchagent/l2nhgorch.cpp#L763-L795)

### Steps to Reproduce

1. Boot SONiC with EVPN NVO configured and Linux interface-bound nexthop objects present.
2. Confirm that `fdbsyncd` receives an `RTM_NEWNEXTHOP` and logs:

   ```text
   NHG <id> has OIF, dropping
   ```

3. Run a forced configuration reload:

   ```bash
   sudo config reload -y -f
   ```

4. Inspect `fdbsyncd`, orchagent, and `swss.rec` logs.
5. Observe that `fdbsyncd` publishes `L2_NEXTHOP_GROUP_TABLE:<id>|DEL` even though it never published a matching SET.
6. Observe the orchagent `deleteL2Nhg` missing-object error.

The issue was reproduced by:

```text
ngts/tests/push_build_tests/general/qos/test_qos_reload.py::test_qos_reload_ports
```

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

### Actual behavior

An OIF-bearing `RTM_NEWNEXTHOP` is ignored, but the corresponding `RTM_DELNEXTHOP` still publishes an APP_DB DEL. Orchagent receives a deletion for an object absent from its L2NHG maps and logs an error.

```text
Ignored NEW → no APP_DB SET → APP_DB DEL → orchagent error
```

### Expected behavior

If `fdbsyncd` ignored the create notification, it should also ignore the corresponding delete notification. Tracked VTEP and group nexthops must continue to generate normal SET and DEL operations.

```text
Ignored NEW  → no SET → no DEL
Accepted NEW → SET    → DEL
```

## Relevant log output


resolution.title: [fdbsyncd]: Ignore deletes for untracked L2 nexthops
resolution.description:
**What I did**

- Guard `RTM_DELNEXTHOP` processing with `m_l2NhgMap` so `fdbsyncd` only publishes a DEL for L2 nexthops it previously accepted.
- Add `FdbSyncdEvpnMhTest.IgnoredOifNextHopDelete` regression coverage for an `NHA_OIF` nexthop whose create is intentionally ignored.

**Why I did it**

An `RTM_NEWNEXTHOP` containing `NHA_OIF` is intentionally dropped by `fdbsyncd`, but its corresponding `RTM_DELNEXTHOP` was still publishing an unmatched DEL to `L2_NEXTHOP_GROUP_TABLE`.

That caused orchagent to receive a delete for an L2 nexthop group that did not exist and log an error.

Fixes #4842.

**How I verified it**

- `git diff --check` passes.
- Added a focused regression test that makes an unmatched DEL observable and verifies that an ignored OIF nexthop does not generate the delete.
- The full `tests_fdbsyncd` binary could not be built locally because the WSL environment does not have the matching SONiC build dependencies (`libswsscommon`, `libsairedis`, `libsaivs`, and related packages). Repository CI will provide the full build/test validation.

**Details if related**

No schema or configuration changes.
